sector: General (pay not fixed by any agreement, determination or regulations)
effectiveNote: Date of the Gazette supplement. The notice does not state a separate commencement date.
payableNote: The notice does not say whether the amount is in US$ or ZiG, so no ZiG conversion is shown. Employers who paid less than this from the commencement date must pay the difference within two months.
excludes: The notice states: "Employers in agriculture and employers for domestic workers are exempted from paying minimum wages." Domestic workers are covered by the Labour (Domestic Workers) Employment Regulations instead.
status: A revision was reported in the news in June 2026. Its gazetted SI had not been located as of 2026-11-20, so this figure may be out of date.
